Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study uses Activity-Based Protein Profiling (ABPP) with an HA-tagged ubiquitin probe (HA-Ub-PA) followed by immunoprecipitation (AP) and DIA-MS. While the study focuses on deubiquitinating enzymes (DUBs) and covalent inhibition, the proteomics workflow itself is an AP-MS approach rather than a remnant-motif enrichment (like diGly) for the ubiquitylome.

scope: HA-Ub-PA-bound DUBs were immunoprecipitated overnight at 4 °C with end-over-end rotation using 150 μL of anti-HA agarose slurry. HA-Ub-PA DUB complexes were eluted with 2x Laemmli buffer, reduced, alkylated, and cleaned up for LC–MS/MS

HDX-MS used recombinant USP30 protein.
